title: Every place and every reveal path a criterion lists needs its own test
rule: When an acceptance criterion lists several places a control appears (wall, list, table, family page header, a sheet) or several ways it is revealed (hover, focus, the keyboard cursor via aria-activedescendant), give each listed place and each reveal path its own assertion. A test for the per-row control does not cover the header one, and a hover-only Playwright check does not cover the keyboard reveal: park the mouse, move the cursor with keys and assert the computed style. Check that removing the CSS rule or the element makes the test fail.
rationale: E48.4 (#527): the family page header compare icon and the wall icon's keyboard-cursor reveal shipped with no test; only the style-row icon and the hover path were checked.
